name: EcoIndex
description: Provides an 'ecoindex' field type plus a browser-side preview that measures a page's EcoIndex score/grade (from the GreenIT-Analysis library) and stores it on content.
project_description:
Back to top 

 What is the environmental impact of your Drupal project? 🌿 
 Unofficial module from the Green IT association. 

 The aim of the module is to help contributors improve their practices and create more eco-friendly content.

 This module uses the open-source library and algorithm developed by Green IT, the creator and maintainer of the EcoIndex service.

 Back to top 

 Workflow 
 Used for the dedicated field type ecoindex to display the EcoIndex score (from 0 to 100) and the corresponding grade (from G to A). Click on the link : "Refresh EcoIndex score" to get current EcoIndex score/grab and come back on edit page to submit values.

 This helps contributors understand the environmental impact of their content and make improvements accordingly.

 

 Back to top 

 Attach EcoIndex on View 
 You can add this information on content view listing.

 

 Back to top 

 Settings 
 The module also lets you set an EcoIndex score for your pages. 

 

 An alert message is displayed if the score is not reached. You can even block publication if the score is not reached.

 

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 Diff Module : To compare EcoIndex scores between revisions.

 

 Back to top 

 References 
 
 https://github.com/cnumr/GreenIT-Analysis 
 https://www.ecoindex.fr 
 https://www.greenit.fr
